title: Pixel’s ‘Flip to Shhh’ notification feature is broken for some
summary: With the Pixel’s “Flip to Shhh” feature on, setting the phone face down silences notifications. Several device models from the Pixel 7 to the Pixel 10 seem to have an issue with Flip to Shhh.
